No family fixture may set up a CONTEXT_SETUP fact; the gap goes when a whole-catalog fleet run lists it in coverage's `closed`.

gaps.palette.toggleDictation: refused at every sample: dictation needs an agent chat composer with the keyboard and a microphone, and the fleet Macs have no microphone, so the refusal is the right answer there; gen_actions.py (p15-oracle-071) still adds a restore toggle that expects ok after a refused toggle
gaps.reconnectPane: unavailable at describe though terminalFocused is the sweep's own context (CONTEXT_SETUP: show('terminal')) and the other terminalFocused rows ran; the likeliest cause is describe answering before the fact was published, which Sweep.described (p15-oracle-085) waits for. No family fixture may set up a CONTEXT_SETUP fact; the gap goes when a whole-catalog fleet run lists it in coverage's `closed`.
gaps.screenGroup.addScreen: needs a screen-group argument: a family ARGUMENTS fixture (p15-oracle-084) runs in the row's plan, before PREPARE, so it would have to make the second screen and its group itself, and the restore has no inverse for a group around a screen it keeps (close_new closes extra screens, not groups); it needs a screen-group fixture with an UNDO (screenGroup.ungroup)
